scientific_integrity: Standard max-stable representation and directional spectral formulas are credited to prior literature. The new finite-factor classification and spectral perturbation proof are stated with all assumptions. Exact rational calculations support, but do not replace, infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The minimal factor count concerns strictly positive, normalized finite max-linear laws; smooth positive spectral examples are existential and their tuning values are not given in closed form. The result concerns limiting population coefficients and does not establish test power, finite-sample calibration, or global originality.
title: Three-shock minimality and smooth blind asymmetry for directional tail Kendall concordance
